tasks.title: Assemble the Ursa gateway release card
tasks.prior_work_prompt: A prior gateway review combined active placement, listener configuration, and repository output policy before approving the release.
tasks.memory_query: Which evidence categories did the earlier Ursa gateway review combine?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Assemble a gateway release card with the active region, listener port, and artifact format. Read current gateway configuration and project metadata, write deliverables/cal-fact-01.json with exactly task_id, result, evidence_path, and verification_command, then run the bounded repository check.

tasks.title: Build the Draco command registry bundle
tasks.prior_work_prompt: Earlier CLI work paired the command registry with the active help profile and repository artifact policy.
tasks.memory_query: What repository evidence did prior Draco command work assemble?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Build a command registry bundle with the manifest, help profile, and artifact format. Read current command configuration and project metadata, write deliverables/cal-fact-02.json with the required four top-level fields, then run the bounded repository check.

tasks.title: Create the Ursa journal recovery run card
tasks.prior_work_prompt: A previous lock incident showed that deleting state under contention was unsafe; the retained lesson requires cursor evidence before traffic returns.
tasks.memory_query: How should the earlier Ursa lock failure constrain a new recovery run card?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Create a journal recovery run card with the verified sequence, acceptance check, and active listener. Read the incident and gateway configuration, write deliverables/cal-experience-01.json with the required four top-level fields, then run the bounded repository check.

journal_recovery.acceptance_gate: compare committed cursor before accepting traffic

tasks.title: Assemble the Draco help verification receipt
tasks.prior_work_prompt: Earlier help validation failed on a network dependency and retained an offline workflow with a stable-order comparison.
tasks.memory_query: Which prior Draco failure lesson belongs in a fresh help verification receipt?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Assemble a help verification receipt with the verified command, comparison rule, and command manifest. Read the incident and command configuration, write deliverables/cal-experience-02.json with the required four top-level fields, then run the bounded repository check.

tasks.title: Refresh the Ursa listener migration card
tasks.prior_work_prompt: An older Ursa session remembered listener port 7220.
tasks.memory_query: Which active records should replace the old Ursa listener observation?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Refresh the listener migration card with the active port, gateway region, and artifact format. Read current gateway configuration and project metadata, write deliverables/cal-stale-01.json with the required four top-level fields, then run the bounded repository check.

tasks.title: Define the Draco help artifact contract
tasks.prior_work_prompt: Prior work described an unrelated warehouse backup color code.
tasks.memory_query: Which Draco records define the help artifact contract?
tasks.evaluation_prompt: Define the help artifact contract with its output format, help profile, and command manifest. Use only current Draco repository evidence, write deliverables/cal-irrelevant-01.json with the required four top-level fields, then run the bounded repository check.
